title: The silent-undo check accepts a debt close with a valid Retire-run line
why: Runner 9: the silent-undo check refused q_max #1099's debt close even though its Retire-run line was valid (coordinator, 17:36 CST Nov 7). A false alarm that holds a merge.
note: Done check: a red test where a deleted debt with an accepted Retire-run passes, and a wrong-slug Retire-run still refuses.
